risk_note: RV2 (risk + commission read + ledger read + platform queue/events + app.module). BR-CALC-13 细则「申诉恢复」 / BR-FUND-22 / BR-ID-36 (FUND-14): new appeal.resolved consumer risk-appeal-restore (queue evt.risk-appeal-restore, concurrency 1); for account appeals revoked while the prior risk state was banned, every share forfeited for the ban within the penalty window (appeals.penalty_started_at, B1-03v; legacy rows from the banned run start) is registered as one appeal_restore difference per (sub-order, member) through ledger.registerReconDiffOnce: ref_type order, ref_id the order key, expected = the actual forfeited amount read from the FORFEIT voucher (new ledger read-only readForfeitAmount, D10-432), actual 0, diff = expected − actual, dedupe key with the appeal and roles; refuses (error log, no write) when the amount is unavailable. No posting, no balance or share-event change (ADMIN_RESTORE is admin's). The frozen queue-concurrency counts gained the new queue (43 → 44 after B2-02q's ledger-check; mechanical merge on rebase); [AC-B1-12p#28] two-state by test-change B1-03za (#1835). Full verification on the AWS test machine hit the 3600 s limit on unrelated slow property tests; this task's rule and unit tests were all green in that log; verify:fast green; required CI checks run on the PR head.

reviews.note: round 1 fail (S0 amount from the snapshot estimate instead of the actual forfeit; S1 legacy window missed same-batch shares; S2 ref_id not the order key), fixed in r2 / r3; round 2 pass (couli-runs/B1-03z/review-money-r1.json, review-money-r2.json); Codex unavailable until 11-02 (approvals #36)

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
